hypothesis: Offline optimal signing followed by positive-forward negative-reverse transfer reduces mean normalized peak cumulative drift by at least 20 percent versus FIFO on the held-out synthetic zero-sum batches, and is no worse on average than one-step greedy reordering.

input.generator: 20 paired integer-vector batches per dimension 2, 4, 8; 4 random vectors and their negatives; random, sorted, and collinear input strata

baseline: FIFO and greedy one-step Euclidean drift minimization; exact subset-DP optimal permutation is an oracle
judge: integer squared prefix norms, exact minimax subset oracle and exact transfer inequality
failure: inequality/correctness violation, less than 20 percent FIFO gain, or worse mean drift than greedy
limits: Offline batches with exact zero sum; no precedence constraints, weights, online, efficient-theorem-construction, or hardware safety claim. Transference is historical, so novel-result incremental value is not established.
